title: SIEM Alert SOC-27-48113: Macro Blocked on SPB-AP-LT-112

fields.rule: Office macro execution blocked by endpoint policy
fields.ruleDescription: Endpoint protection stopped a VBA macro in an Excel workbook under the 'Block macros from internet-origin files' policy. No child process, network connection or file write followed within the 5-minute correlation window.

details.value: Looks like the known freight-forwarder template with legacy macro. Closing unless you object.
From Finance: "Treasury's got something big going this morning. Is IT seeing anything weird?"
